verdict.rationale: Pinecone's docs say its Inference API can rerank results using reranking models hosted on Pinecone's own infrastructure, which is exactly the built-in, first-party reranking this story asks for. That support rests on a single repeated one-line API overview statement, with no deeper documentation or hands-on confirmation. Missing for 10: details on which reranking models are available, documentation of reranking applied directly within index search/query calls, independent or hands-on corroboration of reranking quality.
